title: Umwansi w'umuriro
intro: Mu misi ya mbere y’uguhishurirwa, hari umuntu yaserutse nk’umuntu w’intabarirwa arwanya ukuri. Uwo mutima warahezagiwe n’ubutunzi n’icubahiro, warahisemwo ubwibone kuruta ubuyobozi, maze inkuru yabo ica iba imburi ikomeye cane mu mirongo ya nyuma y’isura.
clues: Nabaye mu gisagara kimwe n’Umuhanuzi, kandi nari mu ncuti ziwe za hafi, yamara ubwibone bwanje bwatumye ntagira ukuri.
Nari mfise ubutunzi bwinshi be n’ibintu vyinshi, kandi niyumvira ko ivyo mfise vyokwama binkingira.
Ubutumwa bumaze guhishurirwa, narabutwengera mw’ijigo ku mugaragaro, ndahindukira, nibona ko nsumba abemera.
Urwanko rwanje rwari ruzwi cane ku buryo sura imwe yo muri Korowani yambwira ata guca ku ruhande, ikamwita mw’izina abandi banzi.
Naragabishijwe ko ubutunzi bwanje n’ivyo nkora bitazompa akamaro, kandi nzojugunywa mu muriro ururumba.
Nzwi ko ndi se w’urubeya, umukenyezi wanje azotwara inkwi afise umugozi w’insinga z’imisukoni mw’izosi.
